definitions.explanation: Not high; close to the ground or bottom.

⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低|ひく}い。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低|ひく}⟦すぎます→すぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低|ひく}い⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。

examples.english: The probability of success is low.

examples.english: I don't want to buy low-quality products.

examples.english: Please be careful because your blood pressure is low.
My mother is short, so she can't reach things in high places.

notes:
{低|ひく}い is an i-adjective meaning low (height/position), short (stature), or low (degree/level).

USAGE:
{低|ひく}い spans physical lowness (height, position), low pitch (voice, sound), and a low level or degree (temperature, quality, probability). The thing that is low is marked with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧.
For people's height, use ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低|ひく}い, not just {低|ひく}い alone. Saying ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低|ひく}い sounds unnatural; say ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低|ひく}い instead.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {低|ひく}く ({低|ひく}く⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧: fly low)
- Noun form: {低|ひく}さ (lowness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低|ひく}い: short (height of people)
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低|ひく}い: low voice
- ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低|ひく}い: low temperature
- ⟦{確率|かくりつ}→確率：00159_kakuritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低|ひく}い: low probability
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低|ひく}い: low quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
Opposite of ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high, tall, expensive).
